description: This is an Android Fragment class that manages the home screen UI in a driver transportation app, displaying user info, date, weather, jobs, and a map.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays home dashboard info including user details, weather, jobs left, date, and a Google Map view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment UI, sets up views, buttons, map, and schedules location updates.

methods.name: numberOfJobs
methods.description: Reads stored job data JSON and returns the count of jobs left for the day.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as 'Day dd Month'.

methods.name: scheduleUpdateLocation
methods.description: Schedules periodic weather updates and job count refreshes every minute.

methods.name: removeHandler
methods.description: Stops scheduled location and weather updates.

methods.name: focusMap
methods.description: Adjusts the map view to focus on current driver location, toggling zoom levels.

methods.name: onMapReady
methods.description: Callback when Google Map is ready, configuring map UI and initial view.
